title: Wallace West Riding School
specs: Riders must be cantering independently to lease horses
Proper helmet and gear required to learn cantering and jumping
After first four lessons, riders aged 7 and up expected to lead, groom, and tack horse
Parties accommodate max 8 friends, 2 horses, 1 lounge
gap: Exact prices for riding lessons not stated
blurb: Guests can take private or small group riding lessons, lease horses, board horses monthly, or host parties with horse activities. Lessons include 30-minute private sessions and 45-minute small group sessions with 5-6 riders. The facility encourages riders to learn grooming and tacking after initial lessons and requires proper helmets and gear for cantering and jumping.
extraNote: 48 hours notice required to cancel lessons for make-up lesson eligibility · Make-up lessons must be booked within two weeks of cancellation unless out of town · Payment required upfront upon registering for lessons · 30 days notice required to cancel registration and give up lesson spot · Weather cancellations posted on social media and emailed, no individual calls
